goal.roundCard.title: Goal round
goal.settings.maxRoundsDesc: Default when a goal does not set its own limit; applies to new goals only. Use /goal limit <n> for a running goal.
goal.note.auto_pause_error: Turn ended with an error; goal auto-paused
goal.usage:
/goal <objective> set a goal and start auto-continuing
/goal stop pause · /goal resume resume · /goal edit <new objective> edit · /goal limit <n> change the round limit · /goal clear delete · /goal show status
goal.roundAborted: Round ended abnormally, goal paused (/goal resume to resume)
goal.noGoal: No goal yet. Use /goal <objective> to set one.
goal.achievedNotEditable: Goal achieved and not editable (/goal clear to delete, then set a new one)
goal.channel.state.label: Goal state
goal.channel.state.desc: Full snapshot of the current session's goal { goal: GoalState | null }. timeline subscribes and tints the composer by phase.
goal.command.desc: Set/manage this session's goal (auto-continue). /goal <objective> to set; stop·resume·edit·clear to control
